entries.title: A crewmate's sign-in card says what to do
entries.body: When a crewmate cannot reach its model, its card now says so in plain words. For a custom connection, it names the connection and says to press Edit and then Save in Settings → Intelligence to check it again. The card no longer shows sign-in commands or file paths from the app.

picture.alt: A provider needs sign in card naming Operator gateway, a custom connection, and saying to press Edit and then Save in Settings, Intelligence
